taken: after the switch of the validation policy, and after the ruling on one comment was carried over to PE-j1 and the tenth receipt was written for the last time
note: A batch's fingerprint holds the eligibility decision of each known problem of its task and of each claim linked to one of its reviews, with the pin of the receipt that decision cites, and each single-comment ruling on one of its reviews. Any later change to the tenth receipt changes the fingerprints of the batches that hold a decision citing it, and this file has to be taken again.

with_the_fingerprints_taken_after_the_sw.why: The tenth receipt was written again with the ruling on one comment, so its hash changed. A batch moved when it holds a decision that cites that receipt: every batch of j-trpc-5017 and y-django-16631, whose known problems GT-j7 and GT-y3 cite it, and on five other tasks the batches with a review linked to a claim of a pre-existing problem. One of the tRPC batches also gained the carried ruling itself. The batches of the nine other tasks did not move.
